page.content:
The weapon is high-tech cybernetic weapon, its blade seems to be some sort of laser or energy beam. In later games Cyrax, along with Sektor, uses a new version of the Sabre called the Pulse Blade.

page.overview:
What is Sabre of Light?

The weapon is high-tech cybernetic weapon, its blade seems to be some sort of laser or energy beam. In later games Cyrax, along with Sektor, uses a new version of the Sabre called the Pulse Blade.
